  match t:
    case Jump s0: f"jump({s0})"
    case Halt n0 if n0 % 2 == 0: f"halt!({n0})"
    case Halt n0: f"halt({n0})"

let calc e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: calc a + calc b
    case Mul a b: calc a * calc b

    case Var v: Map.findOr v 0 vars
let pretty e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({pretty a} + {pretty b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{pretty a} * {pretty b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{pretty a}"
    case Var v: v
let simplify e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): simplify x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e

type Bst = Leaf | Node Bst int Bst
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l

let sumOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt

let containsOf x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsOf x l else containsOf x rt

type Term = Num int | Add Term Term | Mul Term Term | Neg Term | Var string
let vars = Map.ofList [("x", 9), ("y", 8)]
let calc e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: calc a + calc b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: calc a * calc b
    case Neg a: -(calc a)
    case Var v: Map.findOr v 0 vars
let pretty e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({pretty a} + {pretty b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{pretty a} * {pretty b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{pretty a}"
    case Var v: v
let simplify e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): simplify x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): simplify x
    case Neg (Neg x): simplify x
    case Add a b: Add (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (simplify a) (simplify b)
    case _: e

let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListOf l) (List.concat [v] (toListOf rt))

  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt

type Heap = Leaf | Node Heap int Heap
let add x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (add x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (add x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [59, 30, 47, 3, 33, 48] |> List.fold (flip add) Leaf
let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))
print (toListT tree)
let depthT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)
print (depthT tree)

    case Add a b: Add (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case _: e

  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf

    case Node _ _ _: t

    case Node _ _ _: t

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t

  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minT l

  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt

  match t:
    case Leaf: false

    case Node _ _ _: t

  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: calc a + calc b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: calc a * calc b
    case Neg a: -(calc a)
    case Var v: Map.findOr v 0 vars

  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"

    case Var v: v

  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): shrink x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): shrink x
    case Neg (Neg x): shrink x
    case Add a b: Add (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case _: e

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let root = List.fold (fun acc x -> insert x acc) Leaf [37, 54, 18, 2, 9, 56, 30]
let sumT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumT l + v + sumT rt
print (sumT root)
let depthOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthOf l) (depthOf rt)
print (depthOf root)
let toListT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: []
    case Node l v rt: List.concat (toListT l) (List.concat [v] (toListT rt))
print (toListT root)
let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt

let calc e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: calc a + calc b
    case Mul (Num 0) _ | Mul _ (Num 0): 0
    case Mul a b: calc a * calc b
    case Neg a: -(calc a)

  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({pretty a} + {pretty b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{pretty a} * {pretty b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{pretty a}"
    case Var v: v

  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): shrink x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): shrink x
    case Neg (Neg x): shrink x
    case Add a b: Add (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case _: e

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [57, 55, 34, 12, 13] |> List.fold (flip insert) Leaf
let minOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minOf l
print (minOf tree)
let sumOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l v rt: sumOf l + v + sumOf rt
print (sumOf tree)
let depthOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthOf l) (depthOf rt)
print (depthOf tree)
let containsT x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: false
    case Node l v rt: if x == v then true else if x < v then containsT x l else containsT x rt
print (List.map (fun k -> containsT k tree) [57, 14, 19])

type Ast = Num int | Add Ast Ast | Mul Ast Ast | Neg Ast
let evalE e =
  match e:
    case Num n: n
    case Add a b: evalE a + evalE b
    case Mul a b: evalE a * evalE b
    case Neg a: -(evalE a)
let pretty e =
  match e:
    case Num n if n < 0: f"({n})"
    case Num n: f"{n}"
    case Add a b: f"({pretty a} + {pretty b})"
    case Mul a b: f"{pretty a} * {pretty b}"
    case Neg a: f"-{pretty a}"
let shrink e =
  match e:
    case Add (Num 0) x | Add x (Num 0): shrink x
    case Mul (Num 1) x | Mul x (Num 1): shrink x
    case Neg (Neg x): shrink x
    case Add a b: Add (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case Mul a b: Mul (shrink a) (shrink b)
    case _: e
let terms = [(Neg (Neg (Add (Num 5) (Num (-1))))), (Neg (Num 1)), (Mul (Neg (Mul (Num 5) (Num 4))) (Neg (Mul (Num 7) (Num 4))))]
terms |> List.map shrink |> List.map pretty |> List.iter print
print (List.map evalE terms)

type Token =
  | Push int
  | Store int
  | Skip int string
  | Rest int
let explain t =
  match t:
    case Push n0: f"push({n0})"
    case Store n0 if 0 <= n0 < 5: f"store!({n0})"
    case Store n0: f"store({n0})"
    case Skip 3 _: "skip-3"
    case Skip n0 s1: f"skip({n0},{s1})"
    case Rest n0: f"rest({n0})"
let weight t =
  match t:
    case Store x0: x0
    case Push x0: x0
    case Skip x0 _: x0
    case _: 0
let queue = [Skip 10 "gus", (Push 12), Push 1, (Skip (-1) "quin"), Skip 5 "quin", (Rest 3), Skip 10 "dee"]
print (String.join " " (List.map explain queue))
let total = queue |> List.sumBy weight
print f"total={total}"
print (queue |> List.filter (fun t -> weight t > 5) |> List.len)

let readPair line =
  result {
    let! (k, v) =
      match String.split "=" line:
        case [k, v]: Ok (String.strip k, String.strip v)
        case _: Error f"malformed: {line}"
    let! n = Option.toResult f"not a number: {v}" (String.toInt v)
    let! checked = if n < 0 then Error "negative" else Ok n
    return (k, checked)
  }
let lines = ["lu=x", "ada=x", "max=3=1", "jo=x", "fay = 8"]
let parsed = List.map readPair lines
List.iter print parsed
let goodOnes = parsed |> List.choose Result.toOption
print (List.map snd goodOnes |> List.sum)
let firstGood = parsed |> List.map Result.toOption |> List.choose id |> List.head |> Option.map fst
match firstGood:
  case Some name: print f"first: {name}"
  case None: print "none parsed"
let sumAll xs =
  List.fold (fun acc r ->
    result {
      let! total = acc
      let! (_, n) = r
      return total + n
    }) (Ok 0) xs
print (sumAll parsed |> Result.mapError String.upper)

type Tree = Leaf | Node Tree int Tree
let insert x t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: Node Leaf x Leaf
    case Node l v rt if x < v: Node (insert x l) v rt
    case Node l v rt if x > v: Node l v (insert x rt)
    case Node _ _ _: t
let tree = [33, 51, 21, 15, 7] |> List.fold (flip insert) Leaf
let minOf t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: None
    case Node Leaf v _: Some v
    case Node l _ _: minOf l
print (minOf tree)
let depthT t =
  match t:
    case Leaf: 0
    case Node l _ rt: 1 + max (depthT l) (depthT rt)
print (depthT tree)
